records.hook: US Amazon exclusive, a different pressing from the indie Yorkshire smoke one going around.
The Rogue Planet pressing specifically: green glow-in-the-dark splatter, embossed glow sleeve, gatefold, 20-page lyric booklet. Not the standard black, not the Zodiacal Light.
New one on The Flenser, on baby blue vinyl with a fold-out poster and a double-sided insert. Not stocked locally as far as we can see.
Clear vinyl pressing on Mom+Pop. Out of stock at the usual shops right now.
